notes.text: Sefer HaItim gives Yoḥanan ben Akhmai in the Sabbath insulation discussion. Heilprin’s Yoḥanan headword points to Yonatan, and the latter records an alternate Rif attribution. The exact Rif wording is not required to attest the Yoḥanan form, and is not admitted as separately verified here.
The Yonatan form is explicit both in the Babylonian ordination report and in the Jerusalem Talmud teaching reported by R. Abbahu. The different attested forms remain alternatives here.

comparisonEvidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
